William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

On Art and Artists

Give pensions to the learned pig

XIII
G
IVE
 pensions to the learned pig,
Or the hare playing on a tabor;
Anglus can never see perfection
But in the journeyman’s labour.
